supersedes.schema: Nothing: purely additive (no constraint, function or policy redefined).
client: src/lib/supabase/weeks.ts saveWeekToSupabase: select → update weeks → DELETE week_days → INSERT week_days in separate requests (replaced by apply_week).
insertWeekRow retry that saved the week without generation_request_id when the link failed (now an error that rolls everything back).
markMenuGenerationRequestApplied after saving (apply_week marks the request in the same transaction).
Week version weeks.updated_at compared by a separate read before writing (now weeks.version compared inside apply_week / update_week_slot).
Dish edit rewriting the whole week (now update_week_slot, one meal of one day).
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps working with this migration applied (scripts/week-write-db-tests.cjs, scenario 7).

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX week_days_week_id_position_key ON public.week_days USING btree (week_id, "position")

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_weeks_version BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.weeks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION weeks_set_version()
